'''Heler''' was a criminal and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Heler planned to pull off a heist at the [[Ariana Precious Metals Repository]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]] using [[retinal disguiser]] to bypass [[Debri-X Retinal Scanner]]s.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
